description: This file defines the ViewFactory class, which acts as a factory for creating and managing view handlers within the OFBiz framework's web application. It handles loading view handlers from configuration, provides access to specific handlers by type, and ensures default handling when no specific type is specified.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for loading, managing, and providing access to view handlers based on configuration, with default fallback.

methods.name: ViewFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view handlers from the configuration URL and ensures a default handler is set.

methods.name: getViewHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the view handler for a given type, defaulting if the type is empty, and throws an exception if the handler is not found.
